items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He, he, he uh, succeeded uh, Earl Fatha Hines uh, in terms of that overall style...

ctx.x: Players that you really admire or influenced you in how you approach the instrument, how you play and how you think musically.

Well, I mean, I would say uh, in a large uh, uh, uh, the orchestra was Duke Ellington's uh, instrument, but uh, I, I think I'm one of the few people who really appreciates his piano playing while he's involved with his orchestra 'cause it's so spare and then sometimes it's not spare. It's totally unpredictable and he has some runs that I've never heard anybody uh, even come close to. And they're all different so I mean, this is a man I admire heavily uh, the piano. Thelonious Monk, of course, but that's uh, uh,…
